column1: # Alonso Sanchez's cipher (1522), imperial ambassador to Venice, letters to Emperor Charles V / Chancellor
# Mercurino di Gattinara. Reconstruction: Satoshi Tomokiyo, Cryptiana (cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/AlonsoSanchez.htm,
# section "Alonso Sanchez's Cipher (1522)"), from the contemporary decipherment attached to DECODE record R9605.
# Archive: Biblioteca de la Real Academia de la Historia (BRAH), Coleccion Salazar ("M.Re.Ac.d.His.Salazar" in CSP
# Spain); most letters calendared in Calendar of State Papers, Spain, vol.2 (1866). Parsed 27 Sept 2026.
# office: Alonso Sanchez (imperial ambassador, Venice) -> Charles V / Chancellor Mercurino di Gattinara
# design: substitution alphabet + nomenclator (word -> 3-letter code, ordered by 2nd/3rd letter significance)
# note: whole table is Tomokiyo's own cryptanalytic reconstruction from one contemporary decipherment (grade M
# throughout per this job's brief); his own '?' and [bracket] marks are carried into the note column per row.
